## #56 — `commitProposal()` validation errors no longer swallowed

**Root cause:** `bin/mcp/tools.js` `commitProposal()` wrapped the entire `oracle.commit()` call (which calls `validateEntry()` internally) in a single `try/catch`. The catch block was intended to handle missing Xenova/LanceDB embedding deps, but it caught **all** errors — including `validateEntry()` failures.
